surfaces.surface_label: EMA CHMP qualification opinion for Prognostic Covariate Adjustment (PROCOVA), adopted 15 Sep 2022
surfaces.notes: The CHMP adopted on 15 Sep 2022 (document dated 20 Sep 2022) a qualification opinion for PROCOVA, a statistical method using trial subjects' predicted outcomes on placebo (prognostic scores) in covariate adjustment, keyed to sample size estimation. Unlearn's page (captured 23 Oct 2026) presents digital twins of patients for sample-size and comparator decisions. A regulator accepted a model-predicted counterfactual as an input to trial design; this is not a consultation substitute, so the row does not carry democratic_input_replacement. The custody PDF is not text-checked by the tool.

participants.label: European Medicines Agency
participants.role: Regulator whose CHMP adopted the qualification opinion

participants.label: Unlearn
participants.role: Applicant methodology owner and vendor of patient digital twins (PROCOVA is its method per its materials)
